Melissa will be at Alamo Square from 9:30AM to 5:15PM. You'd like to meet Melissa for a minimum of 105 minutes. Joshua will be at Haight-Ashbury from 12:15PM to 7:00PM. You'd like to meet Joshua for a minimum of 90 minutes. Jeffrey will be at Marina District from 12:15PM to 6:00PM. You'd like to meet Jeffrey for a minimum of 45 minutes. James will be at Bayview from 7:30AM to 8:00PM. You'd like to meet James for a minimum of 90 minutes. Anthony will be at Chinatown from 11:45AM to 1:30PM. You'd like to meet Anthony for a minimum of 75 minutes. Timothy will be at Presidio from 12:30PM to 2:45PM. You'd like to meet Timothy for a minimum of 90 minutes. Emily will be at Sunset District from 7:30PM to 9:30PM. You'd like to meet Emily for a minimum of 120 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
After thoroughly analyzing all time‐windows, travel times, and required meeting durations, it turns out that meeting all eight friends would “use up” too many minutes. In our best “maximization” schedule we can fit six meetings into the day while satisfying every friend’s availability and minimum meeting‐time requirement. One feasible (and nearly optimal) solution is as follows:

• You start at Union Square at 09:00.
• You immediately travel (13 minutes) to Russian Hill and meet Betty (who is available 07:00–16:45) for her 105‐minute minimum. This meeting runs from 09:13 to 10:58.
• At 10:58 you depart Russian Hill for Alamo Square (15‐minute trip), arriving at 11:13; you then meet Melissa (available 09:30–17:15, 105‐minute required meeting) from 11:13 to 12:58.
• Leaving Alamo Square at 12:58, you take a 15‐minute trip to the Marina District and meet Jeffrey (available 12:15–18:00, needing 45 minutes) from 13:13 to 13:58.
• Next, you travel from the Marina District to Bayview (27 minutes), arriving at 14:25 to meet James (available 07:30–20:00, 90‐minute meeting) from 14:25 to 15:55.
• At 15:55 you leave Bayview for Haight–Ashbury (a 19‐minute trip) and meet Joshua (available 12:15–19:00, 90 minutes required) from 16:14 to 17:44.
• Finally, you travel from Haight–Ashbury to the Sunset District (15 minutes). Although you arrive nearly 18:00, you wait until Emily “opens” her schedule at 19:30 (Emily is available 19:30–21:30 and needs 120 minutes). You then meet her from 19:30 to 21:30.

This itinerary uses exactly 750 minutes (12½ hours) from your 09:00 arrival at Union Square to the end of Emily’s 21:30 meeting—and each meeting is entirely within the friend’s availability window.

  ]
}

In this plan you meet six friends while adhering to all travel and availability constraints.
